name: duopore-public-meeting-action-register
description: Put meeting tasks, owners and due dates into one clear action list.

interface.longDescription: Put meeting tasks, owners and due dates into one clear action list. Share the actions already agreed in your meeting. See what is due soon, what is late, and which tasks lack an owner or a date. Use simple owner labels where possible. The app does not read meeting transcripts, assign tasks or send reminders.
defaultPrompt: Organize these meeting actions by owner and due date.
Which meeting tasks are overdue or missing an owner?
